purpose: Separate execution completion from evidence acceptance in existing project state.
non_goals: No new controller or FINAL authority.

abstract_mechanisms_observed: Done differs from accepted; dependency changes reopen work.

inputs.name: evidence
inputs.description: Existing state, ledgers, hashes, decisions and reviews.

outputs.name: projection
outputs.description: State, STALE closure, resume point and mutation proposal.

preconditions.statement: State, evidence and dependency hashes validate.

postconditions.statement: Return the highest contiguous supported state, exact STALE closure and earliest resume point.

invariants.statement: Done means at most COMMAND_COMPLETED; artifact does not mean validated, validation does not mean accepted, and accepted does not mean integrated.
TEAM_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW never advances technical state; a supported challenge creates STALE, a finding, a test and re-adjudication.
Only MAIN_AGENT writes existing formal state and ledgers; no second controller or FINAL authority exists.

hard_failures.statement: Reject missing, conflicting, stale or scope-mismatched hashes, evidence, predecessors, freeze, decision or Auditor PASS.
Reject skip-on-done, AUTO_PROCEED, fail-continue, voting, human override and unauthorized writes.

algorithms.specification: TASK_CREATED>EXECUTION_STARTED>COMMAND_COMPLETED>ARTIFACT_PRODUCED>AUTOMATIC_VALIDATION_PASSED>FINAL_EVIDENCE_FROZEN>AUTOMATED_ACCEPTED>FORMALLY_INTEGRATED. Every edge needs its own current hash-bound evidence; acceptance also needs an audited automated decision and Decision Auditor PASS. An audited rejection gives AUTOMATED_REJECTED. A dependency change or supported challenge gives STALE to the root and all transitive dependents, excluding unrelated branches. Resume at the earliest missing or invalid stage; current accepted work skips execution, while accepted but unintegrated work resumes at integration.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Validate edge, evidence, hashes and writer before mutation.
Compute STALE closure and resume point deterministically; never infer missing evidence.

agent_responsibilities: MAIN_AGENT alone applies formal mutations; all other roles only produce evidence or proposals.

stale_propagation.statement: Changed inputs, sources, policy, code, configuration, environment, evidence, Final Run or supported challenge mark all registered transitive dependents STALE; only recomputation clears it.

failure_modes.recovery: Resume at the earliest missing stage.

failure_modes.trigger: Missing hash, conflict, rejection or unauthorized continuation.
failure_modes.recovery: Preserve history and replay from the earliest valid predecessor.

recovery_behavior.statement: Append corrective evidence without rewriting history and follow only registered WORKFLOW.md edges.

audit_events.when: A transition, stale event, resume, review or challenge is evaluated.

security_constraints: No third-party execution or shell, Git, remote, installer or updater control.
Require contracts, hashes, prior-state match and MAIN_AGENT writer identity.
privacy_constraints: Store identifiers, hashes and references, not secrets or raw content.

performance_budget.limit_or_formula: At most once per reachable node and edge, O(V+E).

maintenance_surface: WORKFLOW.md, project-state contract, existing ledgers and tests.

public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Each prefix yields only its supported state.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Before done, after done, after accepted
Input, config, code, Final Run, paper and unrelated mutations
Review, challenge, AUTO_PROCEED, fail-continue and skip-on-done
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Review does not advance; challenge routes STALE/test/re-adjudication; illegal paths fail.

hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: No skipped state; conflicts fail closed; exact duplicates are idempotent.

model_in_loop_tests.input_class: Agent claims done or review means accepted

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: 100% exact state, closure and resume results; 0 illegal advances.

rejection_conditions: Any state distinction or STALE closure is wrong.
Any prohibited continuation, override, vote, inference or competing authority succeeds.
rollback: Disable the projection, preserve history, mark dependents STALE and recompute through existing authority.
migration: Legacy done maps at most to COMMAND_COMPLETED; later states require their own current evidence, otherwise STALE.
unknowns: Exact existing field mappings remain for MAIN_AGENT to resolve without new authority.
open_risks: Legacy conflation or missing dependency edges may cause incorrect freshness.
